theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is eligible under the trend gate, indicating a stable uptrend that has historically limited drawdowns. falsifier.text: Breadth drops below 0.5, durability falls below 0.45, or the theme becomes ineligible (trend gate flips).
